unit.title: A Reliable Browser Vertical Slice
unit.prerequisite: Proficiency in at least one programming language
learning_objectives: Translate a small product brief into explicit, testable behavior.
Separate deterministic domain logic from browser DOM and storage effects.
Build an accessible HTML, CSS, and JavaScript vertical slice.
Test boundary cases and document reproducible verification evidence.

unit_completion_requires: All required implementation and engineering-note deliverables in STUDY_TASK.md are present.
The learner records reproducible test and manual-check evidence.
The learner submits original responses to every prompt in COMPREHENSION.md.
A worker-harness-controlled validator applies examiner_only/RUBRIC.md and records a passing result.
completion_policy.on_pass: Mark only kickoff_01_reliable_browser_vertical_slice complete; keep the course incomplete pending later, separately prepared units.
completion_policy.on_fail: Preserve the attempt and its evidence for revision; do not infer course completion.

provenance.scope_note: The catalog snapshot establishes course identity and points to resources; it does not establish a complete official syllabus or completion of the course.
